verdict.rationale: Granola has a dedicated model-training doc stating users can opt out of model training in Settings at any time, and documents HIPAA compliance for Enterprise customers. The evidence shows only a Settings-level opt-out with no admin-enforced, org-wide control, and says nothing about SOC 2. missing for 10: org-level enforceable training opt-out (admin policy), explicit statement of what data trains models and the default, SOC 2 attestation, independent corroboration.

support.subject: As an IT admin, the vendor documents whether meeting data trains AI models and gives my org an enforceable opt-out, alongside SOC 2 / HIPAA posture

citations.quote: You can opt out of model training in Settings.
You can opt out of model training at any time.
Granola is HIPAA compliant for Enterprise customers.
